car.name: Trailglass 2024
car.description: Original fictional compact SUV referencing the 2024 US Tiguan S FWD seven-seat configuration. Manufacturer drivetrain and dimensional anchors; handling and unprovided engine-curve details are explicit simulation estimates.

catalogProvenance.referenceVehicle: 2024 Volkswagen Tiguan S FWD US, seven seats, 17-inch standard wheels

engine.layout: Front transverse turbocharged/intercooled inline four, 16 valve TSI

gearbox.type: 8-speed automatic, NOT CVT and NOT DSG
gearbox.ratioPrecision: As published to two decimals, do not imply tooth-count precision

mass.note: Use curb, not GVWR or payload. OEM paired imperial/metric values rounded independently.

wheelsTires.source: vw-release confirms S 17-inch,215/65; vw-technical page2 supplies full size

steering.type: Electric power assisted rack and pinion
steering.note: OEM gives range, not an S-specific fixed ratio. Selecting a single simulator ratio is a model estimate.

chassis.frontSuspension: Strut type, lower control arms, coil springs, telescopic dampers, anti-roll bar
chassis.rearSuspension: Multilink, coil springs, telescopic dampers, anti-roll bar

artTrimNotes.panoramicRoof: Not S standard; release makes available on SE and standard upper trims
artTrimNotes.infotainment: Early-year S MIB2 6.5-inch; release says mid-cycle S upgrades to MIB3. Pick and label one, do not mix top-trim cabin.
artTrimNotes.steeringWheel: Reuse game shared steering wheel; not new per-car art

estimates: Original fictional art is not a factory replica; existing steeringwheel reused. Source PNGs inspected and wheel anchors measured; rendered browser and driving QA still pending.

Engine curve has manufacturer torque221lbft@1600 and power-derived torque184*5252/4400 at4400; other samples, torque falloff, idle/redline/revlimit and plateau shape are model estimates. No measured full curve claimed.
8AT gear/reverse/final ratios are manufacturer facts; shift times/thresholds, launchRPM, converter slip/multiplication and drivetrain efficiency are simulation estimates.

59% front static mass distribution,0.64m CG height, collider sections and overhang split are estimates. Front/rear axle-to-CG distances derived from estimated distribution and sourced2.791m wheelbase.
Normalized suspension/antiroll/aero controls, alignment, grip, differential and brake balance are provisional compact-FWD-SUV estimates, not factory calibration.
115mph and8.8sec0-60 are provisional game targets, not manufacturer claims or measured outcomes. Must validate gameplay before integration.
13.3 steering ratio selects upper end of OEM11–13.3 range; simulator uses fixed approximation.35psi tire pressure unsourced estimate, not a placard recommendation.
0.35565m radius is calculated nominal unloaded215/65R17 geometry; loaded rolling radius unknown. Reused tarmac graphics/compound do not claim factory tire brand.
Use OEM1693kg metric NHTSA curb mass for S FWD7seat; do not substitute AWD3818lb or SE3777lb. Rounded paired imperial3732lb is retained in provenance, not falsely precise conversion.
Published fuel and brake dimensions recorded as reference; does not claim separate fuel or geometric brake model wiring.

Wheel anchors are image-space visual estimates. Six oblique/side angles measured from transparent wheel openings; straight front/rear wheel axes inferred behind body corners because shell occludes wheel wells. Placement helper calibrates original image perspective without changing sourced physical geometry.

Oblique wheel fit uses measured vertical opening extent plus2 source pixels, not its narrower horizontal half-width; cover policy fits the largest normalized opening so road stripes cannot show above tires. Shared per-view scale may slightly overfill the smaller opening; graphics only, no physical tyre radius change.
catalogProvenance.artwork: Original logo-free Trailglass SUV body and cockpit, shared existing steeringwheel. Blue-gray and cream salvage body, compact SUV silhouette; not factory replica.
